training.phase1: Binary-only discriminative fine-tuning (stem/layer1/layer2=1e-6, layer3=1e-5, layer4=3e-5, binary head=1e-4); hier/path heads frozen during CV
training.phase2: Multi-head fine-tuning with binary Softmax head frozen throughout: (a) epochs 1-5 hier+path only (encoder+binary frozen, lr=1e-4); (b) epochs 6-15 layer4 unfrozen (encoder 3e-5, hier/path 1e-4); (c) epochs 16-20 full encoder + hier/path at 1e-5, binary still frozen; safety revert if binary patch F1 < 0.85

cascade.note: Patient-level binary only; voxel pathology maps remain plain argmax of Softmax votes

phase1_binary_patch_cv.note: Concatenated OOF patch-level binary F1 with bootstrap 95% CI (1000 iterations)

phase1_binary_cascade_cv.note: 15-fold patient-level cascade mean under Phase-1 CV (primary generalization claim)

phase1_binary_cascade_best.note: Patient-level cascade on best Phase-1 checkpoint before Phase-2

phase2.note: Deployed full-cohort Phase-2 checkpoint (binary head frozen; encoder layer4 refinement)
